text:
kai: heads-up — running the new edge RAG sample (next + LlamaIndex) and telemetry events aren't appearing in Redwood Console for any eval or embed calls. works fine if i run with the node server runtime. :confused:

kai: repro quick steps:
1) clone repo `github.com/redwood/samples/rag-edge-kit`
2) yarn && yarn dev (next edge runtime)
3) run sample query -> UI shows result, but console shows 0 embed_calls, 0 eval.hits

kai: logs show the request reaching the inference node and tokens emitted, but no telemetry POST from the sample app: sample does `await Redwood.telemetry.trackEvent(...)` which resolves.

alex: :eyes: can you paste how you're initializing the SDK in the edge handler? sometimes the polyfilled fetch or middleware strips the internal header we use for telemetry routing.

kai: sure — snippet from /pages/api/llama-edge.js:
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference-js';
Redwood.init({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export default async function handler(req) {
  const r = await Redwood.callModel({ model: 'llama-7b', input: req.body.q });
  Redwood.telemetry.trackEvent('eval.hits', { model: 'llama-7b' });
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(r));
}
```

emma: that looks ok. do you see any 401s or telemetry POSTs in the browser network tab? or are they completely absent?

kai: completely absent. no telemetry POST from client or server. but on node runtime we see a POST to `https://api.redwood.ai/telemetry/v1/events` with payload.

maria: is your edge handler returning early or using `fetch()` that rewrites the request? On Vercel Edge we had a case where `globalThis.fetch = unstable_fetch` shim removed custom headers when followed by a redirect. :thinking:

alex: also check SDK version — telemetry forwarding for edge runtimes landed in v0.11.0. older patches didn't attach the telemetry queue to the edge fetch wrapper, so trackEvent was a no-op (quietly). kai — what's your package.json dependency for @redwood/inference-js?

kai: oof i'm on "@redwood/inference-js": "0.10.3" — that might explain it. but i thought the sample kit was pinned to 0.11 in the template?

emma: template ships pinned to ^0.11 for a week now but older forks can keep older versions. two quick fixes: upgrade SDK to 0.11+; or, as a workaround, call the telemetry flush helper from the serverless path before returning: `await Redwood.telemetry.flush()` (but that only works if the telemetry queue was actually populated).

kai: upgraded to 0.11.2 — now seeing telemetry POSTs in network tab and console shows embed_calls. :partyparrot: Thanks!

maria: excellent. leaving notes: 1) update sample README to explicitly call out SDK >=0.11 for edge runtimes, 2) add a tiny runtime check in the starter that warns if telemetry isn't flushed (we can log at `console.warn` with link to upgrade), 3) add a telemetry unit test for edge in CI.

alex: +1 on adding runtime warning. also can we add an integration test that runs the Next Edge handler in the GitHub Actions matrix? running a lightweight playwright or node fetch against the deployed preview should assert telemetry ingestion.

ci-bot: created issue #1427 (devex) "edge rag sample: require SDK >=0.11 and add telemetry guard" — https://github.com/redwood/samples/issues/1427

kai: awesome — thanks team. filing a quick PR to upgrade deps in the fork and add a README note. will ping when ready for review. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks kai — appreciate the clear repro steps, saved a lot of time.

maria: filing a small docs blurb for the Console team too so they can show a helpful hint when telemetry count is zero but model activity is detected.

kai: will follow-up with PR link shortly.
